query: Please implement a software that generates and submits XML declarations. The software should have data validation capabilities to check the accuracy and completeness of data and ensure its correctness before submission. Users should be able to input data, and the software will automatically validate the data, generate the XML declaration, and submit it to the relevant system. The software should also be able to handle different types of data, including but not limited to text, numbers, and dates. Use misty rose for the background and medium violet red for components.
